name: Flora
description: Local gradient-descent optimizer with optional coupled weight decay; backend-specific options are not supported.

examples.title: Minimize a quadratic bowl with Flora
examples.code:
import torch
from topologies.implementations.optimizers.flora import flora

params = [torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(3.0)), torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(-2.0))]
optimizer = flora(params, lr=0.05)
for _ in range(20):
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    loss = sum((p - target).square() for p, target in zip(params, (1.0, 4.0)))
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()
